intro: A gray bear tongue is a raw reagent harvested from the wild bears roaming the Hillsbrad Foothills. It is sought after by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill to serve as a biological component in their experimental toxins.

p: The untamed wilderness surrounding Tarren Mill is rich in native fauna, including several varieties of sturdy gray bears. While natural predators pose a constant threat to travelers, the Forsaken see them as a harvestable source of raw alchemy components. Apothecary Lydon studies local wildlife to isolate potent organic agents, using the heavy muscular tissue and fluids of gray bear tongues as a base ingredient for concocting lethal solutions such as the Elixir of Suffering.
